title: cvpw analysis/envelope.json
description: Metadata for the per-frame feature blob analysis/envelope.f32. A small JSON sidecar plus a flat little-endian float32 [frames][channels] binary, rather than a large JSON array: the binary is ~20x smaller and loads without parsing. See docs/CONTRACTS.md §5.

fps.description: Frame rate of the feature grid. Matches the project's output fps.

channels.description: Column order in the binary. Reading the blob without this list is meaningless.

layout.description: Human-readable layout statement. Must say row-major [frames][channels], little-endian float32, and where frame i is centred in time.

normalization.description: How each channel was scaled. Recorded because a normalised feature is unusable without knowing the transform.

silentFrames.description: Frame indices with no usable audio. Consumers must treat these as zero rather than as measured silence.

units.description: Per-channel unit or meaning, e.g. `{ "rms": "normalized", "beat": "beat index within bar" }`.

features.description: Band definitions used to produce the channels, e.g. `{ "low": [20, 150] }`.

sha256.description: Optional digest of the .f32 blob, so a mismatch between the sidecar and the binary is detectable instead of producing plausible nonsense.
